title: armeria alpina var. macloviana

It is known for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in the reduction of inflammation and improvement of immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
